mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache Eviction Policy

The project's current recorded decision for the cache layer is to use LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction with a cache TTL of 300 seconds. LRU evicts the least recently accessed entries when capacity is exceeded, and the 300-second TTL bounds the lifetime of every cache entry. The rationale recorded for this decision is that LRU is simpler to reason about and predict.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
